messages.subject: P Marsden — draft Settlement Agreement (v1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alistair,

Further to agreement on terms, I attach the first draft of the Settlement Agreement reflecting: £95,000 ex gratia (first £30k tax free), £24,850 bonus, £4,380 holiday, £5,000 outplacement, £1,500 + VAT fee contribution, reaffirmed covenants with the non-compete recut to 9 months, tax indemnity, agreed reference at Appendix 3 and the adviser's certificate at Appendix 1. Grateful for your mark-up.

Best,
Tom

Tom Gallagher | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: P Marsden — draft Settlement Agreement (v2 mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom — our mark-up attached. Main points: we've pushed the ex gratia and fee figures (you'll say no), asked for the non-compete at 6 months with full garden-leave set-off, the warranty clawback carve-out increased and a notice/cure right, and a latent personal-injury carve-out at 5.3. Most are points of principle for the client; the PI carve-out and the cure right we do need.

Regards,
Alistair Whitlock
Partner, Pemberton Rowe LLP
5 Temple Row, Birmingham B2 5LG

messages.subject: RE: P Marsden — draft Settlement Agreement (v3 — our response)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair — our response attached. Ex gratia stays at £95,000 and the fee contribution at £1,500 as agreed; non-compete held at 9 months; warranty retained sum at £500 with reasonable notice of any claim (we've dropped the 14-day cure mechanic). We've accepted the latent PI carve-out at 5.3. I think we're there — I'll prepare an execution version for signature this week.

Best,
Tom

Tom Gallagher | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
